CAMPAIGN PROGRESS 
BULLETIN 


Cee 


December 8, 1967 


OF GREATER 


MONTREAL 


" Someday the world will need a man 
of courage in a time of doubt 
.And somewhere, as a little boy 
That future man plays about. " 


There is no doubt in the mincs of our key campaign personnel with respect 
to the neec for funds by the YMCA. The recently completed cepth study by all 
units of the Montreal YMCA clearly indicates that increased support is required 
if we are going to effectively meet many of the critical issues facing youth 
today. 


The objectives announced by each Division is a most 
encouraging sign that all of us are equally concerned 
about providing the resources to do the job. 


Official Campaign Objective, 1968 - % 340,000 
Divisional Objectives, however, total - 352,000 
Official Objective, last year, 1967 - 320,000 
Actual raised, last year, 1967 - 308 ,000 


The key to our success will be in relation to how 
prepared we are - Is our organization completed? 
Have we finalized plans for orientation of all 
campaign workers? Are we ready to operate Phase I 
of the Campaign? 

IN PASSING: " Behind every successful business man... 

There stands a somewhat surprised 

mother-in-law " 


John WwW. McGiffin commented the other day that our pre campaign work is 
right on target - all Divisions have secured their key personnel, all materials 
are at the printers, campaign prospect cards are now complete and everyone is 
working hard in preparation for Phase I of our Campaign. 


Paul Zimmerman announced this week that Paul A.Cote has accepted the co- 
chairman's spot on the Metropolitan Special Names Division. Welcome, Paul - our 
thanks to you for your willingness to help. 


CAMPAIGN OBJECTIVE THIS YEAR: $340,000
